an5.78:1.1: bhikkhave anāgatabhayāni sampassamānena alam eva bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
an5.78:1.4: ‘ahaṃ kho etarahi daharo yuvā susu kāḷakeso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā,
an5.78:1.5: hoti kho pana so samayo, yaṃ imaṃ kāyaṃ jarā phusati,
an5.78:1.6: jiṇṇena kho pana jarāya abhibhūtena na sukaraṃ buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ manasikātuṃ, na sukarāni araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevituṃ,
an5.78:1.7: purā maṃ so dhammo āgacchati aniṭṭho akanto amanāpo.
an5.78:1.8: Handāhaṃ paṭikacc'eva viriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya, yenāhaṃ dhammena samannāgato jiṇṇako pi phāsu viharissāmī' ti.
an5.78:1.9: Idaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānena alam eva bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya. 3.
an5.78:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati
an5.78:2.2: ‘ahaṃ kho etarahi appābādho appātaṅko samavepākiniyā gahaṇiyā samannāgato nātisītāya nāccuṇhāya majjhimāya padhānakkhamāya,
an5.78:2.3: hoti kho pana so samayo, yaṃ imaṃ kāyaṃ vyādhi phusati,
an5.78:2.4: vyādhitena kho pana vyādhābhibhūtena na sukaraṃ buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ manasikātuṃ, na sukarāni araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevituṃ,
an5.78:2.5: purā maṃ so dhammo āgacchati aniṭṭho akanto amanāpo.
an5.78:2.6: Handāhaṃ paṭikacc'eva viriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya, yenāhaṃ dhammena samannāgato vyādhito pi phāsu viharissāmī' ti.
an5.78:2.7: Idaṃ bhikkhave dutiyaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānena alam eva bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya. 4.
an5.78:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati
an5.78:3.2: ‘etarahi kho subhikkhaṃ susassaṃ sulabhapiṇḍaṃ, sukaraṃ uñchena paggahena yāpetuṃ,
an5.78:3.3: hoti kho pana so samayo, yaṃ dubbhikkhaṃ hoti dussassaṃ dullabhapiṇḍaṃ, na sukaraṃ uñchena paggahena yāpetuṃ,
an5.78:3.4: dubbhikkhe kho pana manussā yena subhikkhaṃ tena saṅkamanti,
an5.78:3.6: saṅgaṇikavihāre kho pana sati ākiṇṇavihāre na sukaraṃ buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ manasikātuṃ, na sukarāni araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevituṃ,
an5.78:3.7: purā maṃ so dhammo āgacchati aniṭṭho akanto amanāpo.
an5.78:3.8: Handāhaṃ paṭikacc'eva viriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya, yenāhaṃ dhammena samannāgato dubbhikkhe pi phāsu viharissāmī' ti.
an5.78:3.9: Idaṃ bhikkhave tatiyaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānena alam eva bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya. 5.
an5.78:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati
an5.78:4.2: ‘etarahi kho manussā samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharanti,
an5.78:4.3: hoti kho pana so samayo, yaṃ bhayaṃ hoti aṭavisaṃkhepo, cakkasamārūḷhā jānapadā pariyāyanti,
an5.78:4.4: bhaye kho pana sati manussā yena khemaṃ tena saṅkamanti,
an5.78:4.6: saṅgaṇikavihāre kho pana sati ākiṇṇavihāre na sukaraṃ buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ manasikātuṃ, na sukarāni araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevituṃ,
an5.78:4.7: purā maṃ so dhammo āgacchati aniṭṭho akanto amanāpo.
an5.78:4.8: Handāhaṃ paṭikacc'eva viriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya, yenāhaṃ dhammena samannāgato bhaye pi phāsu viharissāmī' ti.
an5.78:4.9: Idaṃ bhikkhave catutthaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānena alam eva bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya. 6.
an5.78:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati
an5.78:5.2: ‘etarahi kho saṅgho samaggo sammodamāno avivadamāno ekuddeso phāsu viharati,
an5.78:5.3: hoti kho pana so samayo, yaṃ saṅgho bhijjati,
an5.78:5.4: saṅghe kho pana bhinne na sukaraṃ buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ manasikātuṃ, na sukarāni araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevituṃ,
an5.78:5.5: purā maṃ so dhammo āgacchati aniṭṭho akanto amanāpo.
an5.78:5.6: Handāhaṃ paṭikacc'eva viriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya, yenāhaṃ dhammena samannāgato bhinne pi saṅghe phāsu viharissāmī' ti.
an5.78:5.7: Idaṃ bhikkhave pañcamaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānena alam eva bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
an5.78:6.1: Imāni kho bhikkhave pañca anāgatabhayāni sampassamānena alam eva bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā ti. 1.
